jobs.prompt:
FILE ACCESS: your declared outputs are readable. Blocker found by the train 8 1-hour soak: the Command Center live input detector scans project FAMILY roots every second. On this machine project-swarm has 313 linked worktrees and parts-request-app 117, so scan() walks 441 roots (each tree(.swarm/project), tree(.swarm/inbox), tree(.swarm/handbuild), and every run state.json) every tick: one scan takes 86-162 ms, the server averaged 32.9% CPU with a dashboard open (limit 5%), and RSS swung 67-361 MB. The full board snapshot still needs all family roots; only the LIVE detector must be bounded.

Fix in tools/watch-server.mjs (keep tools/board-data.mjs projectFamilyRoots unchanged for the snapshot):
1. Export an async helper `selectLiveFamilyRoots(root, { env = process.env, extraRoots = [], now = Date.now, windowMs = LIVE_FAMILY_WINDOW_MS, familyRoots = null } = {})`. Resolve roots with projectFamilyRoots(root, { env, extraRoots }) unless familyRoots is given. Always keep the project's own root. For every OTHER root (a linked worktree/scratch family member), keep it only if it has recent activity: stat these (all cheap, no recursive tree): `<root>/.swarm/runs` directory mtime, the newest run directory by name (ids sort by time) plus its state.json mtime, `<root>/.swarm/project` directory mtime, `<root>/.swarm/inbox` directory mtime, and `<root>/.swarm/orchestrator/events.ndjson` mtime. Keep when any mtime is >= now - windowMs. Missing paths are just not recent (never throw). Use LIVE_FAMILY_WINDOW_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000 so an idle worktree is dropped from the 1 s scan and a newly started run is picked up at the next full rebuild (<=60 s, the existing poll fallback).
2. In rebuildCommandCenterSnapshot, replace the per-project `projectFamilyRoots(...)` mapping for inputProjects with selectLiveFamilyRoots(p.root, { env, extraRoots }) (do NOT change the snapshot's own board.snapshot call or its spend/run data). The returned inputProjects must be the bounded list, not 441.
3. Add tests in tests/command-center-live.test.mjs: (a) selectLiveFamilyRoots with a fake familyRoots list [own, fresh, idle1, idle2] keeps own and fresh and drops the idle roots (create temp dirs; write .swarm/runs/<id>/state.json; set the idle ones' mtimes to now - 1 hour with fs.utimes; assert ids); (b) an idle root whose newest run state.json is touched to now is kept; (c) a missing/invalid extra root does not throw; (d) the existing live-family ownership behavior and latency tests stay green. Keep every existing command-center-live test green.

Performance evidence to report: the bounded root count for this machine (call selectLiveFamilyRoots for /Users/bean/project-swarm and report how many roots remain vs 313), plus the focused checks.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/command-center-live.test.mjs tests/command-center-soak.test.mjs tests/command-center-live-latency.test.mjs tests/watch-server.test.mjs -> all pass.
